events.title: Patrick Henry's 'Give Me Liberty or Give Me Death' Speech
events.description: At the Second Virginia Convention in Richmond, Patrick Henry delivered his famous speech urging Virginia to raise a militia and prepare for armed resistance against British rule.
events.significance: The speech became one of the most celebrated rallying cries of the American Revolution and helped push Virginia toward supporting the cause of independence.

events.title: Elisha Otis's First Passenger Elevator Installed
events.description: The first Otis safety elevator for passengers was installed at the E. V. Haughwout Building in New York City.
events.significance: The safety elevator made tall buildings practical and safe, paving the way for modern skyscrapers and urban development.

events.title: Enabling Act Passed in Germany
events.description: The Reichstag passed the Enabling Act, giving Chancellor Adolf Hitler's cabinet the power to enact laws without parliamentary approval.
events.significance: The act effectively dismantled democratic governance in Germany and established the legal foundation for Nazi dictatorship.

events.title: Gemini 3 Launched
events.description: NASA launched Gemini 3, the first crewed Gemini mission, carrying astronauts Gus Grissom and John Young on a three-orbit flight.
events.significance: It was the first U.S. spacecraft to change its orbit, a key capability for later rendezvous and docking missions that made the Apollo Moon landings possible.

events.title: Aeroflot Flight 593 Crash
events.description: An Airbus A310 operated by Aeroflot crashed in the Kuznetsk Alatau mountains in Siberia, killing all 75 people on board, after the pilot's teenage child was allowed to sit at the controls.
events.significance: The investigation highlighted critical issues in cockpit discipline and autopilot behavior, influencing aviation safety and crew resource management practices.
